An inference service receives 120 requests per second. About 55% have 100-200 prompt tokens and generate 100-250 tokens, 30% have 500-900 prompt tokens and generate 100-200 tokens, and 15% have 2,000-4,000 prompt tokens and generate fewer than 100 tokens. The server uses one GPU, continuous batching, and a maximum active batch of 8. During bursts, GPU utilization stays high but p95 TTFT rises sharply while decode ITL remains stable. The queue grows mostly behind long prompts. Explain the bottleneck and propose a scheduling change that improves TTFT without sacrificing too much throughput.

Write a detailed systems-design explanation of a high-throughput inference server. Cover admission control, continuous batching, paged KV memory, scheduling, prefill/decode interaction, backpressure, metrics, and failure handling. Keep adding concrete details until the response limit.
